slides.title: Search your run sheet for **"networking"**
slides.sub: Then ask three questions of every line you find.
slides.scene: Backstage at a busy conference venue, Phoney the blue phone character holds a huge magnifying glass up to an enormous clipboard run sheet that unrolls down to the floor and across the room like a scroll; Phoney squints with deep detective concentration, wearing a small deerstalker hat.

items.title: Who is in the room?
items.text: If they can't find out before, they spend the break finding out.

items.title: What is the first line?
items.text: A prompt, a question, a reason. Borrowed words beat invented ones.

items.title: Where does it live?
items.text: "An app to install" means about a quarter of the room sees it.

slides.caption: A line with no answers is a coffee break. That's fine. Just call it one.
slides.scene: At a conference break, a long happy queue of attendees waits at a big coffee urn, everyone chatting and laughing in the queue itself; Phoney the blue phone character stands behind the urn wearing a barista apron, pouring coffee with a cheerful wink.
slides.label: No answers?

slides.text: The coffee queue: the only networking format with 100% adoption.
slides.save: 💾 Save this for your next run sheet
